job.what: Discovery-owned worker-side AGGREGATE PROBE for ibama-auto-infracao-recidivism (record next_action step 1; discovery remains owner until this probe). One streaming pass over the full current-vintage auto_infracao_csv.zip (123,308,204 bytes measured 2026-11-04, Azure blob, anonymous): download once on the worker, unzip the per-year members, load into sqlite deduping on SEQ_AUTO_INFRACAO with duplicate-mismatch flags, then compute ONLY source aggregates - per-lavratura-year row counts; entity-key coverage (CPF 11 vs CNPJ 14 digits vs non-standard vs missing, cross-checked against the publisher's TP_PESSOA_INFRATOR); effective-lavratura source mix (DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO vs DT_LANCAMENTO fallback) per year; 12-month re-autuacao base rate per year for first-time and repeat entities (naive and right-censored at the extract's max lavratura); per-window class counts and CLUSTERED positive counts by entity, SEQ_ACAO_FISCALIZATORIA, (year,month), UF and municipality for the record's proposed windows train 2005-2015 / eval 2016-2019 / holdout 2022-2025 plus pre-2005, gap 2020-2021 and 2026 context buckets; SIT_CANCELADO / DES_STATUS_FORMULARIO / TP_ORIGEM_REGISTRO_AUTO mixes per year; current-vintage revision evidence (DT_ULT_ALTERACAO recency per year, TP_ULT_ALTERACAO mix, export-stamp inventory). Constructs NO dataset: no train/eval/holdout files, no labels shipped, no gate, no scoring - source aggregates only, so gate 1.5 does not apply to this job's outputs. Bulk data stays on the worker; artifacts are bounded JSON/CSV reports (max 8 MB). Stopping condition: structural failures (download, missing required columns in every member, zero rows loaded) exit nonzero and leave the partial report for collection; a scientific shortfall (too few positives, poor entity coverage) is a recorded finding in the report, not a job failure. No retry from the same session without a diagnosed cause.
